figurative_meaning_en: To give unwanted or inappropriate advice
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি কেন সবসময় অন্যদের জ্ঞান দাও, যখন তারা চায় না?
এখানে কেউ তোমাকে জ্ঞান দিতে বলেনি, নিজের কাজ করো।
example_sentences_in_english: Why do you always give advice to others when they don't want it?
No one asked you to give your wisdom here; mind your own business.
note: This idiom is often used sarcastically in everyday Bengali speech to dismiss intrusive opinions.
